name: obsidian-crate
description: Sync vault files and reminders with Cloudflare R2.
author: Kaan Biryol

scripts.build:site: npm run build:site:main && npm run build:site:crate-ui
scripts.test:pwa-browser: node scripts/pwa-cache-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-cache-recovery-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-cache-recovery-ui-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-outbox-recovery-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-draft-recovery-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-operation-expiry-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-focus-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-sheet-interaction-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-ui-performance-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-safety-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-auth-recovery-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-push-registration-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-source-issues-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-multitab-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-clock-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-optimistic-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-install-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-update-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-capacity-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-pagination-test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:worker && npm run typecheck && npm run build:plugin
scripts.size-check: npm run size-check:plugin && npm run size-check:worker && npm run size-check:pwa
scripts.release:check: npm run security:check && npm run check && npm run test:pwa-preview && npm run build:plugin && npm run check:css-scope && npm run size-check && npm run verify:release-artifacts && npm run test:pwa-browser && npm run release:candidate
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test:worker-runtime: npm run build:worker && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts
scripts.benchmark:reminders: npm run build:worker && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts src/cloudflare/worker/reminder-capacity.integration.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:worker && npm run deadcode && npm run notices:check && npm run test:recovery && npm test && npm run test:worker-runtime
scripts.security:check: npm run security:audit && npm run security:secrets
scripts.benchmark:sync: npm run build:worker && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts src/cloudflare/worker/sync-capacity.integration.ts --reporter=verbose
